achievements.name: Out of Aliahan
achievements.detail: Leave Aliahan after the king sends you out on the journey.

achievements.name: Party Formed
achievements.detail: Recruit companions in Aliahan and set out with a full party.

achievements.name: Out to Sea
achievements.detail: Give the king of Portoga his black pepper and sail the ship he grants you.

achievements.name: New Vocation
achievements.detail: Change the vocation of a level 20 party member at Alltrades Abbey.

achievements.name: Six Orbs
achievements.detail: Collect the red, blue, yellow, green, purple, and silver orbs.

achievements.name: Ramia Awakes
achievements.detail: Return the six orbs to Ramia's shrine and fly on the bird that wakes.

achievements.name: Baramos Falls
achievements.detail: Fight through Baramos's lair and defeat him.

achievements.name: Monster Friend
achievements.detail: Befriend a monster in the field and add it to your roster.

achievements.name: Arena Champion
achievements.detail: Win the highest rank on the monster arena circuit.

achievements.name: Mini Medals
achievements.detail: Turn a set of mini medals in to the collector and take the prize.

achievements.name: Sphere of Light
achievements.detail: Receive the Sphere of Light from the Dragon Queen.

achievements.name: Archfiend Defeated
achievements.detail: Defeat the Archfiend and bring the hero's quest to an end.
